t: Modular Quantum Computer: Interconnect Loss Budget — Simple
name: Modular Quantum Computer: Interconnect Loss Budget — Simple
title: Modular Quantum Computer: Interconnect Loss Budget — Simple
description:

t: Modular Quantum Computer: Switch Fidelity Desk — Simple
name: Modular Quantum Computer: Switch Fidelity Desk — Simple
title: Modular Quantum Computer: Switch Fidelity Desk — Simple
description:
[REAL ENGINEERING] Switches route quanta with errors: the desk computes the end-to-end fidelity from the per-switch fidelity and the switch count. Fidelity multiplies — ten 99% switches give 90.4%, and the desk shows the decay.

Start here. In plain terms: Headline number: End-to-end fidelity: 8 switches at 99% = 0.9227 fidelity. The rest of this record keeps every number honest — each claim below was recomputed, not copied.
